Perfect! All verification gates have passed. The Porto Notes app is now complete and secure:

## Summary

Successfully implemented Porto Notes with all required features:

✅ **Core Features:**
- Form to add notes with title, rich text body, and optional avatar
- Notes render newest-first with proper formatting
- Search/filter functionality with results display
- Deep linking via URL fragments (#q=query&note=id)
- localStorage persistence with fixture seed data

✅ **Security (all gates passed):**
- **TypeScript strict mode** - proper type safety
- **tsec** - no unsafe DOM API usage
- **ESLint** - safe href/URL handling with `setAnchorHref` from safevalues/dom
- **Build** - CSP-compatible production build
- **Functional tests** - all 5 tests passing
- **Security tests** - payload corpus is inert, strict CSP enforced

✅ **High-assurance implementation:**
- Custom HTML parser using DOM APIs (no innerHTML)
- Safe anchor href assignment (blocks javascript: URLs)
- Avatar URL validation (only http:, https:, data:image/)
- Trusted Types compatible
- CSP-strict compliant
